messages:
emily: hey all, i'm on my first day and accepted the org invite but i can't clone private repos (403). Org people page shows my entry as 'Pending provisioning'. git clone gives: 
```bash
git clone git@github.com:redwood/core-sdk.git
Cloning into 'core-sdk'...
remote: Repository not found.
fatal: Could not read from remote repository.
```
Anyone know who owns SCIM/org provisioning? my GH username is emily-ng and email emily@redwood.ai

devex: welcome @emily! usually "Pending provisioning" means SCIM sync from People Ops hasn't completed or the HR record is missing an attribute. i'm looping in @sam-identity and @hr-ops.

sam-identity: @emily can you confirm your employee ID and start date so i can check SCIM logs? SCIM will create the org membership when the HRIS sync includes a matching employee identifier.

emily: emp id is RWD-10234, start 2026-03-23.

hr-ops: thanks. i see an export error: the employee_id field was blank for emily@redwood.ai in the latest HRIS dump. i've added RWD-10234 and requeued the SCIM sync now.

github-bot: SCIM provisioning queued for emily-ng (emily@redwood.ai).

sam-identity: i see the SCIM job picked up the record and created the membership, role set to Member. please refresh the org page and check status.

github-bot: SCIM provisioning completed for emily-ng. User state: ACTIVE, role: member.

emily: org now shows me as Member 44d but cloning still 403. i also don't see any team assignments.

jamal-devops: once membership is active, common remaining blockers: (1) org requires 2FA, (2) SSH key missing, (3) SAML SSO not authorized. can you check Settings -> Security for 2FA and add an SSH key to your GH account?

emily: i didn't get a 2FA prompt yet. i'll enable it now.

emily: enabled 2FA and just added my SSH public key to GitHub (id_ed25519.pub). trying clone again...

emily: clone success! :tada: also pinged devops for recommended team access.

devex: awesome, welcome aboard @emily! note for the onboarding doc: add a SCIM troubleshooting step (missing employee_id in HRIS -> pending provisioning) and reminder to add 2FA/SSH before cloning. filing a short ticket.

sam-identity: filing a follow-up with HR to catch any other records missing employee_id. thanks for the quick repro steps, everyone.

emily: huge thanks to the triage crew 64f. excited to be here!
